title: Utilizing Large Language Models to Synthesize Product Desirability Datasets

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the distribution of evaluated sentiment scores of LLM-generated synthetic product reviews to identify skews toward positive or extreme sentiments compared to the targeted uniform distribution.
Tracking the frequency and coverage of specific words chosen by the LLM from the Product Desirability Toolkit (PDT) word list to identify overrepresented adjectives during synthetic data generation.
